acorn.definitionKo: 작은 타원형 모양에 갈색이며 겉이 단단한, 묵의 재료로 쓰이는 열매.
acorn.englishDescription: A small brown ovoid fruit with a hard outer shell, which is used to make muk, jelly.

anniversary.definitionKo: 특별한 일이 있을 때, 해마다 그 일이 있었던 날을 잊지 않고 떠올리는 날.
anniversary.englishDescription: The day remembered every year on the same day as the day of a special occasion in the past.

battlefield.definitionKo: 경기나 싸움 등에서 승패가 결정되는 가장 중요한 곳. 또는 그런 때.
battlefield.englishDescription: The most important place in which the victory or defeat is determined in a game, fight, etc., or such a time.
A place of a fight or battle.
A place where war is waged by using a military arsenal.
A place where a war is waged by using an arsenal of weapons.

daeseo.definitionKo: 일 년 중 가장 무덥다는 날로 이십사절기의 하나. 7월 24일경이다.
daeseo.englishDescription: One of the 24 seasonal divisions, said to be the hottest time of a year; it falls on around July 24th.

deteriorate.englishDescription: For some capacity or functionality to be diminished or weakened.

deteriorate.definitionKo: 시간이 지남에 따라 성질이 변하여 기능이 쇠퇴되다.
deteriorate.englishDescription: For the original properties of a substance to change as time passes.

deteriorate.definitionKo: 시간이 지남에 따라 성질이 변하여 기능이 쇠퇴하다.
deteriorate.englishDescription: For the original properties of a substance to change as time passes.
For the nature or property of an object to change.
For the state of an injury, etc., to become worse.
For the strength or power to gradually decline.

deteriorate.definitionKo: 강하게 일어났던 현상이나 세력, 기운 등이 약해지게 되다.
deteriorate.englishDescription: For an influential phenomenon, power, energy, etc., to get to be weakened.

deteriorate.definitionKo: 강하게 일어났던 현상이나 세력, 기운 등이 약해지다.
deteriorate.englishDescription: For an influential phenomenon, power, energy, etc., to be weakened.
For an incident or situation to proceed in a wrong direction.
For the symptoms of a disease to grow worse.
For an incident or situation to proceed in a wrong direction.
For the symptoms of a disease to grow worse.
To change the nature or property of an object.

haoche.definitionKo: 언어에서, 상대 높임법의 하나로 상대편을 보통으로 높이는 종결형.
haoche.englishDescription: In language, a final form of respect that raises the other person to a normal level.

imperturbability.definitionKo: 마음에 어떠한 자극을 받아도 흔들림이 없이 아무렇지 않음.
imperturbability.englishDescription: The state of looking calm and not being shaken however one is stimulated emotionally.

inventor.definitionKo: 지금까지 없던 새로운 기술이나 물건을 처음으로 생각하여 만들어 내는 것을 전문적으로 또는 직업적으로 하는 사람.
inventor.englishDescription: A person who professionally comes up with and makes new technologies or objects that did not exist before.

inventor.definitionKo: 새로운 물건을 만들거나 새로운 생각을 내놓는 사람.
inventor.englishDescription: A person who creates new things or comes up with new ideas.

pose.definitionKo: 어떤 동작이나 행동을 할 때의 몸의 모양.
pose.englishDescription: The shape of the body when performing a certain movement or action.
The state of being made to look good only on the outside.

pose.definitionKo: 그림이나 사진 등에서 인물이 취하는 자세나 모습.
pose.englishDescription: The posture or appearance taken by a person in a painting or photograph.
To assume a posture in front of someone or a camera.

pose.definitionKo: 사실은 그렇지 않은 사람이 어떤 당사자인 것처럼 꾸미어 행동하다.
pose.englishDescription: To fake one's identity, passing oneself off as someone else.

spring.definitionKo: 어떤 느낌이나 힘 등이 강하게 생기다.
spring.englishDescription: For a certain feeling, energy, etc., to grow stronger.
The act of jumping forward powerfully.

spring.definitionKo: 네 계절 중의 하나로 겨울과 여름 사이의 계절.
spring.englishDescription: The season between winter and summer.

spring.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어렵고 힘든 시기가 지나가고 새롭게 오는 희망의 날들.
spring.englishDescription: (figurative) A time of new hope after a period of difficulties and hardships.
For a feeling or emotion to surge.

spring.definitionKo: 땅속에서 맑은 물이 솟아 나오는 곳. 또는 그 물.
spring.englishDescription: A place in the ground from which clear water comes out, or such water.

spring.definitionKo: 샘물이 솟아 나오는 곳이나 그 언저리.
spring.englishDescription: A place in the ground from which clear water comes out, or such water.

spring.definitionKo: 나사 모양으로 빙빙 돌려 감아 잘 늘어나고 줄어들게 만든 물건.
spring.englishDescription: A screw-shaped object that is coiled round and round, made to stretch and shrink easily.

spring.definitionKo: 나사 모양으로 빙빙 돌려 감아 잘 늘어나고 줄어들게 만든 물건.
spring.englishDescription: A screw-shaped object that is coiled round and round, made to stretch and shrink easily.

spring.definitionKo: 봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울의 네 계절.
spring.englishDescription: The four seasons of a year.

spring.definitionKo: 강철로 된 얇고 긴 띠를 돌돌 말아 그 풀리는 힘으로 시계 등을 움직이게 하는 장치.
spring.englishDescription: A roll of a long, thin steel strip that is unrolled to generate power to move a clock, etc.

virus.definitionKo: 유행성 감기, 소아마비 등의 감염성 병원체가 되는 아주 작은 미생물.
virus.englishDescription: A microorganism that acts as an infectious agent in influenza, polio, etc.
A program that makes a computer work abnormally.

virus.definitionKo: 사람들을 병에 걸리게 하거나 음식을 썩게 하는 아주 작은 생물.
virus.englishDescription: A very small organism that makes food rot or people sick.

virus.definitionKo: 사람들을 병에 걸리게 하거나 음식을 썩게 하는 아주 작은 생물.
virus.englishDescription: A very small organism that makes people sick or food rot.

wiggle.definitionKo: 몸의 한 부분을 자꾸 비틀거나 구부리며 움직이다.
wiggle.englishDescription: To keep moving while twisting or bending a body part.
